changes.PART2D:034: You are quite uncouth, Mr. Yamada.
changes.PART2D:042: You are remarkably roundabout, Mr. Yamada. And unpleasant.
changes.PART2D:044: When the Great Japanese Empire went to war with Russia, did you not come crying to Britain and Her Majesty the Queen for aid, knowing you could not prevail alone?
changes.PART2D:045: And even now, you remain under my control.
changes.PART2D:047: Your trainer must have been lamentable. You still have not learned the proper relation between master and servant.
changes.PART2D:049: Managing the whole world is no small burden. I wonder whether even the savages under our protection can comprehend it.
changes.PART2D:051: Even now, you are not at liberty to defy me.
changes.PART2D:056: The attendant's room is across the hall. The adjoining room is unused. The room at the far end is occupied by Braque's secretary.
changes.PART2D:059: A gentleman does not gulp his tea like that. Excuse me.
changes.PART2F:141: Regrettably, Director. Our investigation confirms that Heynwood and Burns are Russian agents.
changes.PART2F:143: Then every allegation made by Russian Fog was correct.
changes.PART2F:146: Considering all the circumstances...I believe there is only one answer: defection.
changes.PART2F:147: A Russian spy defecting to the British Empire?
changes.PART2F:150: We cannot allow such a prize to escape us.
changes.PART2F:151: It may be bait intended to draw you out.
changes.PART2F:152: I accept the risk. If it comes to that, I still have nerve enough to take my own life. This is no work for a younger man. Let me have one last assignment before I retire.
changes.PART2F:153: Take Ashby with you. He may prove useful.

notes.Ashby: Edwardian British establishment register: controlled, hierarchical, polished, and personally condescending. Fewer contractions and more formal syntax; no phonetic RP or caricature.
notes.Voysey_cover: Impeccably correct servant/valet register. Deference is conveyed by syntax and restraint, not exaggerated butler catchphrases.
notes.Voysey_revealed: Dry, concise senior intelligence-professional register. When reporting upward as Deputy Chief, he becomes markedly more formal and precise.
notes.Director: Senior institutional British voice: economical questions and orders, little ornament. His authority should contrast with Ashby's grandiosity.
notes.source_priority: Voice changes are layered only after the retail-Japanese semantic corrections for these records. Source-authored historical oddities, including Ashby's reference to Her Majesty the Queen, are preserved.
